S0_candidate.head: 67aa483a3a5ac445b01a3dc2849889afa19ce057
S0_candidate.scope: US S0 snapshot inspector only; Draft/HOLD remains

Terminal_reference.relationship: Personal portfolio is a distinct owner; do not substitute its bookKey for bot S0 identity

Macro_reference.relationship: engine/portfolio.py risk-budget reference is not bot held-account ledger

native_controls.copy: Research and decision history are distinct; compact amounts are value/unrealized P&L; target-risk action identifies its basis

valuation_consumption.withheld: Keep every holding and known cash; total and full-account weights unavailable. Do not value at cost or zero.
valuation_consumption.provisional: Display available source-computed value with its provisional qualification and affected rows.
valuation_consumption.qualified: Preserve source status but do not equate it with explicit close, currency or FX attestation.
valuation_consumption.strict_nav_limitation: strict=True rejects WITHHELD but still returns numeric PROVISIONAL; current empty dictionaries can also yield QUALIFIED.
valuation_consumption.evidence_projection: Add evidence availability beside the incumbent result; no parallel valuation enum, amount calculation, service or store.

evidence_requirements: Account and mark references bound to one selected valuation
Canonical held population shared by totals and coverage denominator
Explicit source, observed session/date, adjustment basis and close eligibility when claimed
close_qualified === true where eligible-close assertion applies
Known input/output currency and consumed rate/operation evidence where conversion applies
FX receipt alone does not establish source convention or execution qualification

S0_integration_gap.required: Extend the incumbent bound projection; do not add a new account or valuation engine; preserve Draft/HOLD and US scope.

navigation_rules: Today Open holdings opens existing77-0/14D-0 in held mode
Opening details changes presentation of the same selection, not silently to latest
Later generation is explicit choice; suppress stale late response overwrite
Unavailable selected snapshot remains unavailable; no default book or latest fallback
Book switch cannot carry US S0 reference into another book
Filters change visible subset, not account total
Close/Back restores original row, scroll and focus
Research/history remain bound to selected instrument; target review remains bound to accepted decision
Target risk needs matching target report; never scale/copy held beta
Method & sources uses selected report provenance
Any selected-view export must preserve the chosen reference and declared basis; current export integration is not proved here

responsive_rules.product_390: Fluid card wrappers, existing selected-navigation subtrees retained verbatim
responsive_rules.proof_320: Separate native width320 content specimens in existing build page; summary stacks, body fits, nav allows at least76px for Opportunities and flexible44px-min other destinations

acceptance: Missing mark preserves row/cash, withholds NAV and full weights
Complete numeric prices with unattested evidence remains provisional or preview, not fully attested
Empty evidence entry cannot acquire a stronger UI claim from QUALIFIED alone
Carry and future mark boundaries retain observed dates and source behavior
Missing/incompatible FX evidence prevents verified converted-total claim
A→B concurrent generation and late-response suppression
Missing selected snapshot and cross-book changes
Held/target report separation and correct S05 fallback
Keyboard row selection,44px actions,close focus restoration,Back continuity
Real consumer integration proof at selected snapshot, not just fixture tests
